scientific_scope: Read-only deterministic diagnostic using already-consumed K4N source; not an independent experiment, new learner, prospective transfer or scientific first-use.

diagnostics.source_only: Use original public reset observation 128D FIT/DEV feature vectors and original real public-action reward outcomes. NEVER call CausalWorld or create new samples.
diagnostics.nearest: K4I original per-action raw 1NN with squared Euclidean distance; ties lower FIT variant; action chosen highest predicted reward with lower action ID tie break.
diagnostics.verification: Exact recompute original full12/fit_fidelity4/coverage4/outcome_aware4/uniform4 action choices for all eight reaching DEV contexts and eight pushing DEV contexts in both original process records. Fail closed on any discrepancy.
diagnostics.counterfactuals: Reconstruct full arm3 minus FIT7 only, minus FIT8 only, minus both; test FIT-only selected coreset plus FIT7 or FIT8 as fifth record and optionally same-capacity replacement. All are hindsight diagnostic only and no tuned positive.
diagnostics.information: Count unique FIT and DEV public observations, FIT/DEV winner-action labels, original public-feature nearest distances, and disagreements. Assess train-context preservation vs unseen-context errors and mark unidentifiable root cause separately. Never infer minimum capacity from one posthoc replacement.
diagnostics.mandatory_outcome: K4N original NO-GO remains NO-GO, even if diagnostic predicts action3 for DEV19.

next_prospective_hypothesis: Only after this retrospective diagnosis: in a new preregistered simulation with unfamiliar task families, test whether a shared compact predictive-state representation improves reward/reusable causal transfer per fully counted storage/computation/experience relative to fitted conventional controls. Do not reuse K4N DEV or mine favorable source cohorts.
